# Do you need consent to record this call?

> Pick the caller's and recipient's US states and get an instant one-party vs. all-party call-recording consent determination, the exact statute cited, and a ready-to-read disclosure script for your call opening. Free, deterministic, runs entirely in your browser — not legal advice.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
